preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in the input (N, array elements, Q, and K values) are between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) >= 2 and all(int(x) <= 50 for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit() and int(x) <= 100)
preconditions.description: The first integer N is the size of the array (1 ≤ N ≤ 50). The array follows on the next line, and Q (number of queries) is on the third line (1 ≤ Q ≤ 10).
The input consists of exactly N+2 lines: one for N, one for the array, one for Q, and Q lines for queries.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.split()) == 1 for stdout_line in stdout.split('\n') if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each line of stdout is a single integer representing the answer to a query.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout_line) <= (N * (N + 1)) // 2 for stdout_line in stdout.split('\n') if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a non-negative count of subarrays (≤ N*(N+1)/2, the total possible subarrays).

postconditions.expression:
all(int(stdout_line) == sum(1 for i in range(N) for j in range(i, N) if min(A[i:j+1]) == int(K) if (K_line := next((line for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() == K), None)) else False) for K, stdout_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.split('
')[Q+2:Q+2+Q]], stdout.split('
')) if K.strip() and stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each query K, the output line is the count of all subarrays A[i..j] where the minimum element in the subarray equals K. The subarrays are defined as contiguous sequences A[i], A[i+1], ..., A[j] with 0 ≤ i ≤ j < N.
